conditions: off has original Harness tools including web_search/web_fetch; on adds only citeweave_search and its guidance
timing: turn_start event received to turn_end event received; excludes separate vLLM readiness prewarm and CLI startup; processSeconds includes CLI startup but not model prewarm
imagePolicy: actual returned images only; no invented URLs
coldEvidence: same prompt requests refresh=true when offered; proxy records actual request and cache_hit
limitations: Small illustrative sample, not a statistically powered evaluation
No blinded quality score assigned by runner
Provider auxiliary web_search may itself use an additional LLM
Model and external web retrieval are nondeterministic; cache/token prompt reuse affects timings
Baseline native web tools remain available; plugin choice is autonomous
No user Desktop configuration is changed
initialWarmupIncludes: Model startup and one evidence request, outside all timed trials
nativeFetchEnvironmentObservation: Current Windows DNS returns fake-IP/non-public addresses for several websites. Harness web_fetch rejects them. Both conditions retain identical native tool/network configuration. This is an environmental confound; native fetch errors must not be generalized as an inherent Harness limitation.
temporarySystemChanges: None. Model watcher and idle timeout unchanged. Runtime.session prewarm performed before each timed trial.
releaseRelationship: Trials used plugin source b57e489 and backend deployed branch441b803, before the0.5 release. Subsequent release repackaging is not the benchmarked container or commit.
